110111201.text: This price is fair. Well then, I'll get that custom order done for you.

110111203.text: Worry not, just leave it to me.

subQuests.subQuestName: Take Teucer out to the toy store

110110101.text: Eh? What are those super-colorful winged things?

110110102.text: They're called kites. The kids in Liyue love them!

110110103.text: Hello there, dear! You look like you've come a very long way. Let granny guess — from what you're wearing, I would say... Snezhnaya?

110110104.text: Hee-hee, that's right. How do you play with these kite things, Granny?

110110105.text: When the wind picks up, you let out the string, and whoosh! The kite will fly into the air, up, up and away!

110110106.text: Wow... That's amazing. Do you have any Mr. Cyclops ones?

110110108.text: I wanna fly Mr. Cyclops high into the sky so all the kids can get to know him!

110110109.text: Well, I can do custom builds, but I'll need some amount of reference material...

110110110.text: Will this picture do? I drew it myself. I bring it with me everywhere!

110110111.text: Hmm... I'll manage. Still, I must warn you that custom builds can really be quite expensive...

110110112.text: Ah, we should be fine, Childe was pretty generous with that entertainment fund...

110110113.text: Um... But then again, throwing money around willy-nilly is, y'know, kinda irresponsible...

110110115.text: Well, um, so... Yes, technically speaking, these funds are earmarked for Teucer's entertainment... But, if there's any left over when we're done...

110110118.text: Either way... it's time to talk prices!

110110117.text: Eh-heh, your words not mine! But yes, we're on the same page here.

110112501.text: Huh! I for one would like to see what this dandy boy's made of...

110111601.text: Children, children, I do hope you're not trying to make a mockery of me.

110111602.text: I'll stick to my price, and not a Mora less... If you seriously want this custom build, then I would hope you can be serious about the price.

110111603.text: Sorry, Granny! We didn't mean it like that... Alright, Granny, we'll go with your price.

110111604.text: That's more like it. Not to worry, now. Just leave it to me.

110110402.text: Wait, he's talking to... the Treasure Hoarders?

110110403.text: You know what I'm here for, I trust?

110110404.text: Oh, you've got lip. Makin' us guess, are you?

110110405.text: If you wanna join up, let me just say this first — dandy kid like you? You ain't welcome.

110110406.text: Oh ho. What a commendable imagination.

110110407.text: Well, in the Tsaritsa's name, I suppose I should forgive you country bumpkins for your ignorance. For I am—

110110409.text: You're selling them toys, aren't you, brother? That's so cool! I've always wanted to watch you work!

110110410.text: ...Why, yes, of course! For I am, uh...

110110416.text: ...So, will you buy, or not? The toys that Snezhnaya produced three months ago will run you... yes, 600,000 Mora. To be paid in full.

110110418.text: Wow, is that what it's gonna cost to fix that head of yours?

110110420.text: Look at that! Spreading joy and laughter to everyone — that's what toy selling's all about!

110110421.text: I'll say it again. Toys from Snezhnaya, three months prior, 600,000 Mora, paid in full.

110110422.text: Yeah... No. Sorry, salesboy — the same joke isn't funny twice.

110110423.text: Or were you always cruisin' for a bruisin'?

110110424.text: *sigh* Alright then, I'll make things a little easier for you. I'll join the Treasure Hoarders. Perhaps you'll be more willing to pay when we're brothers-in-arms?

110110425.text: Huh! Would you listen to yourself!? You think we just let any old person into the Treasure Hoarders? I'm not so sure you could hack it...

110110426.text: *chuckles* Well then, why don't you put me to the test, dear seniors? I like to think of myself as quite talented in the field of treasure hunting.

110110427.text: Hmph, looks like you're not gonna pack it up until someone packs you in. Alright then. Show us what you got.

110110428.text: Truth be told, we've set up shop here because there's a fine little loot cave nearby. But the treasure hasn't been easy to get at. We've been at it for two days now.

110110429.text: If you think you're up to snuff, why don't you have a crack at it on our behalf? 'Course, that means that once you've got it, it's ours. Don't you try to sneak off with the prize, now...

110110430.text: Hahaha... Come on. If we can't do it, do you really think this guy stands a chance?

110110431.text: An initiation test, eh? Interesting. It's been a while since I've been assessed by someone else.

110110432.text: The loot's on the <color=#00E1FFFF>opposite cliff</color>. We're gonna hang back here and watch the show...

110110433.text: No problem. Don't blink, though, or you might miss it.

110110501.text: Teucer. So you did come here!

110110504.text: Shh... Quiet, my brother's giving his speech!

110110505.text: ...From this day forward, you will honor the oaths you have made to Her Majesty the Tsaritsa, and you will stop at nothing to bring Snezhnaya victory.

110110506.text: You shall sweep through this land like the icy winds of the furthest north, as strong as the hoar frost of Zapolyarny Palace. You will chill the very marrow in our enemies' bones!

110110507.text: Her Majesty expects of you loyalty, ruthlessness, and meticulousness...

110110508.text: For the trials that we face are harsh, and our enemies are like...

110110511.text: Who shall become redoubtable foes of Mr. Cyclops in the marketplaces of Liyue...

110110512.text: Uh-huh. Kites are really fun, too.

110110514.text: This is, of course, an analogy. As they say, "the marketplace, too, is a battlefield."

110110516.text: So as your... sales manager here in Liyue, I demand that you obey my every order.

110110517.text: A refusal shall be considered a betrayal, and the price for betrayal is to be dishonorably discharged from... Ahem, from the Liyue Institute of Toy Research.

110110518.text: Whoa, that's really strict... Won't people be really sad if they get fired from the Institute?

110110521.text: (Seeking to please everyone pleases no one at all. Time to try something else...)

110110522.text: Forget it. Perhaps a round of hands-on training will suit us better.

110110524.text: After all... a strong body is the proof of one's capacity.

110110525.text: Hey. Did... did he just say that we're doing hands-on training?

110110526.text: A Harbinger wants to spar with us personally? Wh—What an honor!

110110527.text: I can't believe it... are recruits like us really worthy?

110110528.text: Am I hearing a hint of objection to this idea?

110110531.text: Now, come at me, you lot.

110112101.text: *sigh* All this haggling and wrangling... At this rate, everyone's appetites will be ruined.

110112102.text: I won't argue with you any further. You can take my price, or you can take your order elsewhere.

110112103.text: Um, we're sorry, Chef Mao. We didn't mean to make you mad. We'll pay what you asked — all this bargaining's made us hungry too.

110112104.text: Ha, now that's better! Go find a place to sit. Your food will be with you shortly.

110112401.text: Blergh, it was a little... too sweet. Paimon feels a little sick...

110112402.text: I thought it was just right! Almost exactly like how sister Tonia makes it!

110112403.text: But this doesn't feel right, somehow... Didn't we bring Teucer here to try Liyue's specialties?

110112404.text: ...Meh, whatever. So, where do you wanna go next, Teucer?

110112405.text: The <color=#00E1FFFF>wharf</color>! I was so caught up looking for my brother when I first got here that I didn't get a good look around.

110112406.text: Good idea. The hustle and bustle at the wharf is a specialty of Liyue Harbor too.

110110201.text: Wow, this place is huge! And there's so many people!

110110202.text: Are the waves here always like this? Don't they ever freeze?

110110203.text: Uh, given Liyue's climate, the area around the harbor's mouth probably never gets cold enough to freeze.

110110204.text: Paimon is kinda the Traveler's exclusive personal tour guide, but... since this is a special occasion, Paimon can make an exception to help Teucer get to know the place.

110110205.text: This place is Liyue's commercial hub, and it's been the biggest port in the seven nations ever since it was decided that Liyue would take on the world through trade.

110110206.text: Other than merchant vessels, many fishing boats and industrial transports dock here to replenish their, uh, fishery supplies and daily necessie— necessities, which, thanks to the... immense... throughput capacity of the wharf... Um...

110110209.text: Uh... Yeah, Paimon can't remember how the rest goes anyway...

110110210.text: Well, guess Paimon will just have to explain this Paimon-style! So, this harbor is like Teyvat's mouth, and it's the biggest mouth you've ever seen.

110110211.text: All the nations float their boats over the sea into the mouth. The harbor goes om-nom-nom-nom-nom and has a taste of each boat and the cargo it has on board...

110110212.text: Then, Liyue Harbor rubs its big round belly in satisfaction, because it's all stuffed full of delicious Mora!

110111001.text: That metal hook is huge! And it gets bigger the closer we get!

110111002.text: This is an anchor. Docked ships use it to hold themselves in position, to stop the wind and waves from blowing them away.

110111004.text: But I think I might get it mixed up with Commodore Hook...

110111005.text: Commodore Hook? Is this another one of your weird toy names...

110111006.text: My brother always sends me a really big toy for my birthday.

110111007.text: Commodore Hook, Blacksteel Jack, Iron Tony... We keep them all in our backyard.

110111010.text: Yeah, and that's why I can't bring them with me all the time. It's a shame...

110111011.text: Wow, using Fatui funds for personal gain. To think Snezhnaya would let their Harbingers do that, all for some giant toys...

110111012.text: But suddenly, it doesn't seem so strange that Teucer would treat a Ruin Guard as a giant toy...

110111013.text: But my favorite has to be Mr. Cyclops. Even though I mostly came here to see my brother, the other big thing I wanted to do was play with Mr. Cyclops!

110111014.text: Ooh, are they selling fish over there? Let's have a look!

110111401.text: Hmm, this price is a little too low...

110110901.text: Is this where they sell fish? Wow, the fish here in Liyue are so... small.

110110902.text: Hey! Whose fish are you calling small? Little kids shouldn't go around ruining others' business.

110110903.text: He's just a curious kid... No need to get worked up...

110110904.text: That said... These fish are actually pretty big by Paimon's standards. Just how big are the ones you're used to, Teucer?

110110905.text: Um, maybe two hundred times your size?

110110909.text: There are legends in my hometown about it. It's supposed to be a super delicious fish.

110110910.text: I told my brother about it, and he went out to sea to catch one for me.

110110911.text: A few days later, he returned with a humongous fish slung over his shoulder. Anthon and I were so happy...

110110912.text: Are you sure that was a fish? Paimon thinks it sounds more like some sort of... leviathan...

110110908.text: Hey! Two hundred of Paimon would squish you flat, you know!

110112001.text: Hey now, come on. I can barely cover the cost of the ingredients at that price.

110111102.text: What's wrong, Teucer? Are you tired? You don't seem so happy.

110111104.text: What? But we were just with him!

110111105.text: Yeah, but for such a short time that it doesn't count!

110111106.text: Take me to see my brother! I don't want to play anymore!

110111108.text: Yep, you can have all the patience in the world, but it won't help you at a time like this...

110111110.text: Well, we've played with Teucer long enough, haven't we? Paimon thinks we've tried our best here...

110111111.text: Childe said that he'd be by <color=#00E1FFFF>the river near Qingxu Pool</color>. Why don't we look for him there?

subQuests.subQuestName: Bring Teucer to where Childe is

110110601.text: Well then. Do you all understand what I said earlier?

110110603.text: Excellent. And, you all almost managed to get me limbered up.

110110605.text: You have done well — for new recruits.

110110608.text: Now, then. I wish you all glorious victory — for Snezhnaya, for Her Majesty the Tsaritsa, and for yourselves.

110110611.text: Oh, Teucer! What in the world are you doing here?

110110612.text: There I was thinking that the Traveler had taken you to play at Wangshu Inn, haha!

110110616.text: Haha. I told you, didn't I? I never pass on an opportunity to improve my strength.

110110617.text: I'm not the man I was when we first met.

subQuests.subQuestName: Complete the Treasure Hoarder's test by obtaining the treasure

110111801.text: Ah, you folks... *sigh* Let's go with this, then. Any more haggling, and we'll ruin the other customers' appetites.

110111803.text: Please sit wherever you like. Your food will be here shortly.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Slippery Wu and attempt to obtain the treasure again

110112801.text: The loot's on the <color=#00E1FFFF>opposite cliff</color>. We're gonna hang back here and watch the show...

110112802.text: No problem. Don't blink, though, or you might miss it.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the member of the Treasure Hoarders

110110701.text: Well, I have the goods. Here you go. So, how'd I do? Pretty well, I'd say.

110110702.text: B—Brother... What do we do? This fellow isn't normal...

110110703.text: Please... hold on a moment, sir. We need to discuss something amongst ourselves.

110110704.text: He ain't here for an initiation. He just wanted to show off.

110110705.text: Honestly, we'd be no match for him if he wanted a fight...

110110706.text: Guys... do you think that maybe...

110110708.text: I don't know... surely he wouldn't have come here all dressed up like that if he was only after us? Unless... Maybe his words have hidden meaning?

110110709.text: Snezhnaya, three months, 600,000... Oh, I get it! It was insider talk!

110110710.text: I remember that the boss took out a 600,000 Mora loan from that Snezhnayan bank about three months ago, and still hasn't repaid it.

110110711.text: So this guy must be the debt collector... But why didn't he just say so? What's with all the toy talk?

110110712.text: Haha, and that's where you're still green. See, in a lot of professions like this, people speak in code to protect the privacy of their business partners and clients.

110110713.text: Makes sense... Owing money is pretty embarrassing.

110110714.text: This guy isn't one to mess with, I tell you. He's a professional. Way too professional.

110110715.text: So, Mister... Salesman. My apologies, but we can't have you joining us.

110110716.text: Oh? I didn't pass? I must say, I never imagined that the Treasure Hoarders would have such strict entry requirements...

110110717.text: No, it's not that. What we mean is that you're too big a fish for our little pond.

110110718.text: But we fully understand the situation with the... uh, toys, sir — we'll fetch that 600,000 for you right away.

110110720.text: I see. Well then, it's been a pleasure doing business with you. We get paid, and everyone stays happy. A wonderful outcome, wouldn't you say?

110110722.text: That's my brother for you! Toy sellers are so cool!

110110726.text: A new batch of fresh recruits have just...

110110727.text: Hey now, keep your voice down. Can't you see I'm entertaining some clients over here?

110110728.text: Clients? ...Uh, well anyway, the motherland has dispatched a new batch of recruits to Liyue. They've just arrived, and I'm afraid we must trouble you to speak to them...

110110729.text: Ugh, do I have to? Now is hardly the best time...

110110730.text: I must apologize for troubling you, Master Childe, but they are already waiting for you <color=#00E1FFFF>south of Lingju Pass</color>...

110110731.text: Every new batch of recruits must be baptized by the Tsaritsa's will through the words of her Harbingers. This has always been our rule.

110110732.text: At present, Master Childe, you are the only Harbinger in Liyue. Please, everyone is standing in formation and waiting for you to bestow this honor upon them...

110110733.text: Well alright then, I'll go. Just give me a moment to catch up with my brother, and I'll be right with you.

110110734.text: Do you have to keep working?

110110735.text: Yes, Teucer. We have a group of new toy sellers fresh in from the motherland, and I need to go teach them the ropes.

110110736.text: Wow, that's great! When I grow up, I wanna be a toy seller too! Can I go listen?

110110737.text: #Hmm... I'm afraid you're still too young, Teucer. I'm not sure if you'd understand much of it, and most of it's rather boring, anyhow. Why don't you go play with the {M#Traveler guy}{F#Traveler lady} instead? Sound good?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Childe's location to look for Teucer

110110801.text: Looks like we'll be hanging out with Childe's kid brother for a while...

110110302.text: Whew, this restaurant has a really... choking smell...

110110303.text: A "choking smell"? You must be referring to our signature spicy chili scent.

110110304.text: Spicy chili? But I... can't eat spicy food.

110110305.text: Ah, what a pity. A person who can't eat spicy food misses out on half of life's joys.

110110307.text: My meals have to have lots and lots of sugar, and the oil has to be extra virgin vegetable oil.

110110308.text: Wow, we've got a real rich kid on our hands...

110110309.text: Looks like Wanmin Restaurant's dishes aren't to Teucer's tastes... Maybe we should go somewhere else...

110110310.text: —Will that be all? Any more special requests?

110110311.text: Eh? What do you mean, Chef Mao?

110110312.text: Ha! Giving the people what they want is the very reason Wanmin Restaurant exists.

110110313.text: If I thought for one second that I couldn't make a dish to satisfy this child's tastes, I would have absolutely no business calling myself a chef ever again.

110110314.text: Whoa, there seems to be a lot of professional pride riding on this...

110110315.text: Then we'll leave it to you, Chef Mao. We will be eating here after all.

110110317.text: But let me say this first: special requests are going to cost you more than normal.

110110318.text: Of course, we aren't going to demand prices anywhere near as exorbitant as the likes of Liuli Pavilion or Xinyue Kiosk.

110110319.text: Is it just Paimon, or are premium custom orders in fashion lately?

110110320.text: Still... Hehe... Surely there must be a little room for negotiation, right?

110110802.text: So, so, so where are we going to play first?

110110803.text: Um... how about we start with the <color=#00E1FFFF>toy store</color>?

110110804.text: For our next stop... why don't we head to <color=#00E1FFFF>Wanmin Restaurant</color>?

110110805.text: It would be a mighty crying shame to come all the way to Liyue and never try the food!

110111301.text: *sigh* Fine, fine. I've neither the time nor energy to bargain with you at my age. I suppose this price will do.

110111303.text: Worry not, just leave it to me.

110111501.text: No, that won't do... This amount won't even pay for the materials...

110111701.text: Done. I'll go prepare the food, then.

110111702.text: Great! It's time for a nice meal!

110111703.text: Please sit wherever you like. Your food will be with you shortly.

110111901.text: That seems a bit on the low side... You do realize these dishes will be prepared specially to your requirements, don't you?

110112601.text: As long as I'm watching, he's not getting away with the treasure!

110112701.text: Seems mighty confident... Maybe he really does know a thing or two...
